description.narrative: The project involves construction, commissioning and operation of a 50MW solar power plant and integration into the grid for further electricity sale per a fixed tariff. The project is located approximately 30 km east of the city of Kyzylorda in the Kyzylorda Oblast, an area with high insolation of between 2,200 and 3,300 hours of sunlight per year, translating to 1,450 to 1,750 kW/m2 annually.
